scope: Only trusted rustfmt on two fresh owned workcopy files. No copyback, Cargo, original/shared source, browser or server.

command.requires: Before launch archive both exact before bytes, create only owned workcopy of both, generate reviewed fresh workcopy/runner pins. Formatter output is limited to workcopy source paths. Produce normal diff; do not copy before root review.

ownedResourceGuard.cleanup: only newly created unnamed owned jobs and exact returned Popen process handles; no PID/name termination

stdoutPolicy: Raw stdout/stderr remain separate unfiltered logs; hash and report both. Never treat stdout as source or apply it. Require owned guarded exit0, exact file-set/UTF8 checks and immutable-source audit. Any warning/output is available for root review with the ordinary diff; preview success authorizes no copyback.
finalAuditPolicy: After the fixed owner fully closes owned jobs/handles, compare all protected input hashes before/after decisively. Compare archived before bytes to original source pins. Permit candidate changes only at workcopy/src/lib.rs and workcopy/src/tests.rs, reject symlinks/extra file outputs. Capture candidate hashes + normal unified diff; never introduce a custom lexer or copy actual sources.
futureApplyGate: Root reviews normal diff, logs and exact candidate hashes; then a separately reviewed scoped copy/pin refresh and separately reserved fmtcheck/test/Clippy window. Original seven-test accepted evidence retained.
